end.summary:
Practised making 100 with tens numbers, including 30 + 70 and 80 + 20.
Practised counting jumps on a number line, such as 94 to 100 and 46 to 50.
Vihaan gave 70 for the partner of 30 and 20 for the partner of 80.
For 65, they said 45 instead of 35; this mix-up was not corrected later.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making 100 and counting jumps on a number line with Vihaan. They used the idea that 30 + 70 and 80 + 20 make 100, and counted several jumps aloud. For 65, they added the digits to make 10 and chose 45, so this needs revisiting; it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, use quick pairs such as 65 + __ and ask Vihaan to check the total by counting up to 100.
